pool.text: Raja Abdullah first developed Kuala Lumpur as a town serving tin mines.
The Ampang mines successfully exported the first tin from the area.
Yap Ah Loy was appointed as the third Chinese Kapitan of Kuala Lumpur.
Kuala Lumpur was captured and burnt to the ground during a conflict.
Kudin recaptured Kuala Lumpur in March by defeating Raja Mahdi forces.
The colonial administration moved the state capital of Selangor to Kuala Lumpur.
Kuala Lumpur became the birthplace of Hashing initiated by British colonial officers and expatriates.
The Imperial Japanese Army captured the city of Kuala Lumpur.
Japanese forces surrendered to the British administration following bombings.
The Sanitary Board officially became the Kuala Lumpur Municipal Council.
The very first municipal election in Kuala Lumpur was held.
The Federation of Malaya gained its independence from British rule.
The Malaysian Houses of Parliament were completed near the Lake Gardens.
Sultan Abdul Aziz Shah Airport served as the main international gateway to Kuala Lumpur.
Kuala Lumpur hosted the official Asian Basketball Championship alongside other later years.
Severe race riots broke out in Kuala Lumpur on May thirteenth.
Kuala Lumpur achieved official city status after independence.
Kuala Lumpur officially became a federal territory under direct control.
The mini-bus service was operated in Kuala Lumpur starting from September.
Total open space for recreational and sports facilities land use measured 5.86 square kilometres.
